description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Color', which is responsible for validating CSS color values, including named colors, RGB/A, HSL/A functions, and hexadecimal color codes. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library's attribute validation subsystem for CSS.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Color
classes.description: A class for validating CSS color values within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given CSS color value string, including named colors, rgb/rgba/hsl/hsla functions, and hex codes; returns either a validated color string or false if invalid.
